name: Ehud
summary: A left-handed man of Benjamin whom the LORD raised up to free Israel from Eglon, king of Moab. After killing Eglon he led Israel to victory, and the land had rest eighty years.

key_moments.title: Kills King Eglon
key_moments.description: Ehud strapped a two-edged dagger to his right thigh and brought Israel's gift to King Eglon. Alone with the king, he said he had God's message for him, then drew the dagger with his left hand and killed him.

key_moments.title: Escape and Victory
key_moments.description: Ehud locked the doors and escaped while the king's servants waited outside. He sounded a trumpet in the hills of Ephraim, led Israel to seize the Jordan crossings, and Moab was defeated.
